prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all change types (sign_in reorder, home new_flow, adoption copy, finish notification) since each has only been tested once.
Reordering sign-in performed poorly (-5.2% after noise correction) and was stopped early, but evidence is still thin to form a permanent rule.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow, adoption copy, or finish notification changes.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -5.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] waiting_screen_desktop_prep: Insert a desktop canvas prep screen before waiting to check rendering settings and screen overlay permissions. (why: 3 support emails report pet not displaying on desktop or app failing to open, causing high mean waiting time (2336s).)
1: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_interactive_controls: Upgrade home_intro screen to a stage layout with choice cards explaining desktop pet interaction and menu controls. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step drops to 64.8%.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_split_redesign: Redesign choose_path screen into a split layout showcasing preset pets versus custom creation side by side. (why: choose_path screen loses 23.8% of users and has a long mean time of 514s, indicating confusion between paths.)
3: [home, wait_info] waiting_time_estimate_and_tips: Display dynamic progress, estimated wait duration, and a tip carousel on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step (home target_step) has a long mean time of 2336s and median of 201s, causing user impatience.)
4: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_account_hint: Add clear hint text on sign_in explaining that logging into an existing account preserves saved pets. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
5: [adoption, copy] upload_photos_error_prevention_copy: Update photo upload screen copy with clear instructions on image lighting and facial visibility. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong during adoption setup.)
6: [finish, notification] home_intro_ready_notification: Enable ready notifications and status badge on home_intro when desktop setup finishes. (why: Finish step mean time is 5815s (96 minutes), indicating users background the app while waiting for desktop pet activation.)
7: [sign_in, layout] sign_in_compact_layout: Switch sign_in screen to a compact layout with a step counter to streamline sign-in execution. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to load, and sign_in conversion is 72.9%.)
